settings.heading: A new home for your collection
settings.body: Considering selling a statue or a collection? Tell us what you have, where you are based and its condition.

settings.title: Tell us about the piece
settings.text: Character and studio, scale if you know it, and where you are based.

settings.title: Describe the condition
settings.text: Original box and inserts, any repairs, chips, loose parts or missing accessories.

settings.title: Share photographs
settings.text: Several angles in good light, including the base and any damage.

settings.title: We respond
settings.text: We will come back to you to discuss the piece and what might happen next.

settings.heading: What to send us
settings.body: Include the studio, scale if known, original packaging and any repairs or missing parts so we can discuss the next steps. Photographs help us understand the piece before we reply.

settings.label: Original packaging
settings.hint: Box and inserts, yes or no

settings.heading: Tell us about your collection
settings.body: The more detail you can give, the more useful our reply will be.
settings.note: Sending an enquiry does not commit you to selling, and does not create an agreement.
settings.message_label: Tell us about the piece or collection
settings.message_hint: Character, studio, scale, condition, original packaging, any repairs or missing parts.
settings.photo_note: If you have photographs, mention it here and we will reply with where to send them.
settings.success: Thank you — your enquiry has been sent. We will reply by email.
